def test_max_element():
    # Basic positive integers
    assert max_element([1, 2, 3]) == 3
    assert max_element([5, 3, -5, 2, -3, 3, 9, 0, 124]) == 124

    # Max at the beginning
    assert max_element([10, 2, 8, 1]) == 10

    # Max at the end
    assert max_element([1, 2, 10]) == 10

    # All negative numbers
    assert max_element([-5, -3, -1, -10]) == -1

    # Single element
    assert max_element([42]) == 42

    # Duplicates of the max
    assert max_element([7, 7, 7, 7]) == 7

    # Mixed positives and negatives
    assert max_element([-1, -2, -3, 0]) == 0

    # Floats
    assert max_element([1.5, 2.7, 0.3]) == 2.7
    assert max_element([-1.5, -2.7, -0.3]) == -0.3

    # Unsorted with repeated values
    assert max_element([3, 1, 4, 1, 5, 9, 2, 6, 5, 3]) == 9

    # Empty list should raise IndexError
    try:
        max_element([])
        assert False, "Expected IndexError for empty list"
    except IndexError:
        pass
